scope: Independent static review of final command-runner/handoff and updated native gates before actual final bundle execution. No full validator rerun performed by reviewer.

resolved_findings.problem: Final command receipts bound logs but not exact checked input bytes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Runner now binds triplet, all evidence capture bytes, proposed payloads, original edited owners and actual validator/schema sources. It asserts unchanged hashes after executions and attaches exact binding-manifest hash to receipts. Native and handoff verify every bound current byte and receipt manifest/log hash before reporting success.
resolved_findings.verification: Static exact-byte review plus changed bound-input and wrong manifest-receipt negative controls in native prefix.

resolved_findings.problem: Handoff emitted all188 review/PASS claims without checking loaded audit or saved-native statuses.
resolved_findings.resolution: Handoff now requires188 unique decisions, all complete independent reviews, auditor188 complete accounting with no scientific approval, zero command exit codes/current log hashes and current input bindings; saved native completion must be completed, verdict needs_curation, and population/target count188.
resolved_findings.verification: Static exact-byte review; native prefix additionally rejects a missing independent case.

write_scope: Runner writes worker validation logs/reports/input bindings/receipts. Invoked structural, strict LinkML and overlay tools read maintained inputs and write only stated reports. Handoff writes worker conflict hints, progress, agent scopes, HANDOFF and case table. Native builder writes worker prospective report content only; native append/save remains separate root action.

negative_controls.scope: Unchanged AST prefix of latest native builder through validation gates; actual final source report not generated by this test.

accounting_assessment: Counts come from final artifacts with fail-closed audit gates. Cross-worker hint overlap is correctly described as potential scope, not another worker proposal or approval. Previous auditor retry is explicitly reused rather than claimed rerun. No commit/push completion is asserted before a post-push receipt exists.
limitations: Final actual receipts, saved native target IDs, final combined field preservation and staged diff must still be reviewed after root executes assembly/checks/save.
The runner binds listed actual validation inputs; final bundle manifest is responsible for remaining process/handoff files.
Existing native append-only check success is a final execution fact to verify from its retained receipt; this script review does not substitute for that check.
